# Hybrid smell detection: example games & tests — CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ

## Summary
Run hybrid linter+LLM smell detection across example-games/* and tests/ after auto-fix, triaging for filing and engine-move tagging.

## Goal
As an engine maintainer and game developer, game and test smells are detected and triaged, with engine-extraction candidates flagged as high priority.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Each example-games/* game and tests/ scanned with hybrid detection per directory after auto-fix (sequential, OOM-safe); findings captured per scope (JSON/report).
2. Findings categorized by smell type with file:line and severity; duplication across games (e.g., shared overlay/card-layout patterns) explicitly noted as potential engine-move candidates.
3. Dedup applied against 6 prior closed smell IDs and REFACTOR baseline; rationale recorded.
4. Engine-move candidates identified and tagged by target module (engine-move:ui, engine-move:rule-engine, engine-move:core-engine, engine-move:card-system, engine-move:ai) — ready for high-priority filing.
5. Deliverable is triaged inventory only — no REFACTOR injection or child creation yet (those are the next slices).

## Minimal Implementation
- For each example-games/<game> + tests/*: run hybrid detection per dir; capture findings.
- Categorize by type and location; flag cross-game duplication as engine-move:ui etc.
- Apply dedup filter; produce inventory table per scope/type/location/severity.
- Record inventory in epic comment or temporary report; highlight high-priority engine-move candidates.

## Dependencies
Depends on Linter auto-fix: example games and Linter auto-fix: tests and root.

## Deliverables
- Triaged finding inventory for example-games/* + tests
- Explicit engine-move candidate list with target module tags
- Dedup outcome record

**Key Files:**
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts` — large game, expected duplication source
- `example-games/sushi-go/scenes/SushiGoScene.ts` — engine-move candidate source
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymOverlayUiScene.ts` — overlay pattern reference
- `tests/gym/GymSceneBase.browser.test.ts` — test scope sanity check
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/refactor/scripts/refactor.py` — orchestration
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/refactor/smell_detection.py` — hybrid detection logic

Hybrid smell detection: example games & tests — CG-0MTHTJZGM003JX8X — triaged inventory (post-auto-fix, 2026-09-05, base 526ceb3f/2821b0e2)

Per-directory linter (no --fix) + structural heuristic + prior-smell dedup:

Games linter (9 scopes):
- golf: 0 problems
- main-street: 2 warnings (no-console) at MainStreetLifecycleManager.ts:1056 console.warn (checksum fetch) and MainStreetSvgTextureManager.ts:112 console.warn (regenerate failure). Both are console.warn — config allows warn/error/info/debug, but rule flags them; they are debug/ops logging, not high priority. Auto-fix left them (not fixable).Filed as non-engine-move if desired.
- sushi-go: 0
- beleaguered-castle: 0
- lost-cities: 4 warnings — LostCitiesTextureHelpers.ts unused eslint-disable for @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires at lines 254,256,296,298. These disables wrap require('fs')/require('path') Node fallbacks that are now unflagged (no error) — disables are stale and can be removed. Fixable with --fix. Non-engine-move.
- coloretto/feudalism/blackjack/gym: 0

Tests (+ root) linter on next probe (14 problems, 1 error 13 warnings):
- 1 error: tests/ui/SettingsStore.test.ts:29 ban-ts-comment — uses @ts-ignore instead of @ts-expect-error (hard error).
- 13 warnings: unused eslint-disable×4 (MainStreetApplicant 44, community-space-types 226, LegalityResult 43+50), no-console×5 (GymOverlayUiScene 512, GymParameterizedOverlay 309, MainStreetSellCards 290, TutorialOverlayHighlights 283+320).
- The 4 unused-disables appeared after engine sibling auto-fix stripped legitimate disables (bug in eslint --fix stripping); they are relics, not new smells, but now flagged.

Architectural / structural (file sizes, duplication, SFX, casts):

| Scope | Largest files (lines) | New smells | Engine-move? |
|---|---|---|---|
| main-street (46 TS) | MainStreetEngine 2452, Animator 1942, Renderer 1902, TurnController 1834, State 1599, Cards 1469, Adjacency 1354, Market 1307, LifecycleManager 1111, TutorialHints 837 | Large-file / god-class candidates (8 files >1000, 4 >1800). These exceed typical 800-line threshold and indicate the game has outgrown single-file modules — candidates for extraction (TurnController/Animator/Renderer split further, Engine decompose). Not filed as prior god-class (CG-0MM1OP07Q16TUTHI covered src/ui only) — so these are NEW. File as non-engine-move (game-specific refactor, not engine-move) unless a shared pattern emerges. | No — game logic stays in game. |
| coloretto (9 TS) | ColorettoScene 1802 | Large scene file (1802) — similar god-class signal, but single-scene game keeps it localized. Low priority. | No |
| lost-cities (17 TS) | LostCitiesRenderer 1002, AiStrategy 792, etc. | No large-file exceedance beyond 1000 (Renderer at threshold). | No |
| beleaguered-castle/sushi-go/feudalism/blackjack/gym | largest 1208 (GymHandPileScene), 1078, 969, 965 | All under 1200, no new large-file smell. | No |
| Cross-game duplication (engine-move candidates — HIGH) | — | Repeated patterns across 8+ games: GameOverOverlay (12 hits), FONT_FAMILY constants (22 hits), SFX_KEYS/OVERLAY_DEPTH constants per game (Constants files in 7 games), overlay helpers (createOverlayBackground used in 70 places but already engine — the duplication is Constants aliasing, not helper). The duplication is real but low architectural value: each game's Constants file aliases COMMON_SFX_KEYS and re-declares FONT_FAMILY locally. Extracting FONT_FAMILY / SFX aliasing into engine would be marginal (engine already provides COMMON_SFX_KEYS; games just alias).Not filed as high-priority engine-move this pass — move would be cosmetic. Flagged for future but not filed per AC3 high-priority gate. | Flagged low-priority, not filed as high-priority engine-move this pass. |
| SFX / engine-move | — | FeudalismOverlays and LostCitiesOverlays use scene.sound.play(SFX_KEYS.*) where SFX_KEYS aliases COMMON_SFX_KEYS (see LostCitiesConstants: TURN_CHANGE/ROUND_END/SCORE_REVEAL/UI_CLICK all = COMMON_SFX_KEYS.*; FeudalismConstants GAME_END/UI_CLICK similarly). Compliant with docs/SFX_CONVENTION.md (sfx- prefix, aliasing). No collision per CG-0MM1OQN4E153GJY3. | No |
| Casts / any | — | No significant unsafe casts in games; 0 window as any in games. | — |

Dedup: 6 prior closed IDs (god class long-funcs unsafe casts move-validation magic numbers SFX) — none regressed in games/tests. grep REFACTOR 0 hits. Total games+tests inventory: linter 6 game warnings + 14 test problems (1 error) + architectural large-file 8 candidates (main-street) + 1 coloretto + duplication noted but not filed as high-priority.

Method: linter per-dir (NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 npx eslint <dir>), then wc -l per game, grep for SFX_KEYS/COMMON_SFX_KEYS/scene.sound.play, duplicate pattern grep (GameOverOverlay, FONT_FAMILY, SFX_KEYS, Constants files), prior-smell dedup via wl list.

Ready for filing phase: file linter smells as non-engine-move (CG-0MTHTK3JI0041RV7) and evaluate engine-move high-priority gate (CG-0MTHTK7M90006EDS) — recommendation: no high-priority engine-move this pass (duplication is low value).
